in_sanskrit.name: Śivakumāra
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who protects (kumāra) the Lord Śiva (Śiva)

in_hindi.name: शिवकुमार
in_hindi.long_meaning: शिव के रक्षक (Shiva ke rakshak) - The one who protects Lord Shiva

in_tamil.name: சிவகுமார்
in_tamil.long_meaning: சிவன் உடன் வாழ்வும் குமார் (Civaṉ uṭaṉ vāṙvum kumār) - The one who lives with Lord Shiva

in_telugu.name: శివకుమార్
in_telugu.long_meaning: శివ పరిశోద్ధో (Śiva pariśōdhha) - The one who serves Lord Shiva

in_marathi.name: Sivakumar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord Shiva + Protector
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sivakumar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Siva is the name of Lord Shiva, the Hindu god of destruction and regeneration. Kumar means protector or guardian. So Sivakumar means Lord Shiva, the protector.
